name: Dungeon boss kit spells aimed at players need line of sight
contract: Several Ascension kit spells carry SPELL_ATTR2_IGNORE_LINE_OF_SIGHT, so bosses hit players behind walls, as our tester
saw with Curse of Arugal. These six spells, all aimed at a player or in a cone in front of the boss, now need line of
sight through coa_dungeon_spell_reach. Room-wide mechanics and melee strikes keep the flag.

steps.label: Death Speaker Jargba: Shadow Bolt Volley (2102781) needs line of sight
Landslide: Hurl Boulder (2100732) needs line of sight
Amnennar the Coldbringer: Steal Warmth (2100709) needs line of sight
Mother Smolderweb: Mother's Milk (2102215) needs line of sight
Stomper Kreeg: Booze Spit (2100189) needs line of sight
Tendris Warpwood: Entangle (22994) needs line of sight
CONTROL: Zevrim's Sacrifice (2100215) still ignores line of sight
